mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past month, or the rank IC between FEDFUNDS change and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 250.0 signals high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or the rank IC between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.2% and decline in employment (PAYEMS) below 148,000 thousand signals a labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.2 and PAYEMS < 148000, or the interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) has a rank IC below 0.05 with SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 thousand units, it indicates a late-cycle expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1300, or the rank IC between HOUST and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rose over the past month, or the rank IC between UNRATE change and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a supply contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the rank IC between INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 500,000 million dollars and CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0, it signals strong consumer demand amid high inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 500000 and CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or the interaction term (RSAFS * CPIAUCSL) has a rank IC below 0.05 with SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation and high-policy-rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, leading to negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has a rank IC below 0.05 with SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.
